question: The average monthly expenditure of a family was Rs. 10,000 during the first three months. Rs. 12,500 during the next four months, and Rs. 13,500 during the last five months of a year. If the total savings during the year was Rs. 32,500, then 70% of the average monthly income of the family (in Rs.) was:
solution:
Given:

The average monthly expenditure of a family was Rs. 10,000 during the first three months. Rs. 12,500 during the next four months, and Rs. 13,500 during the last five months of the year.

Total savings during the year was Rs. 32,500,

Concept used:

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Calculation:

Total expenditure over a year = 10000 × 3 + 12500 × 4 + 13500 × 5 = Rs. 147500

Total income of the family over a year = 147500 + 32500 = Rs. 180000

Hence, the average monthly income of the family = 180000 ÷ 12 = Rs. 15000

Thus, 70% of the average monthly income of the family = 15000 × 70% = Rs. 10500

**∴ 70% of the average monthly income of the family (in Rs.) was Rs. 10500.**
